change.title: Extract the behavior-preserving AuthorityTransaction facade
change.summary: Adds the bounded S5 AuthorityTransaction facade over the existing one-click authority capture, verified snapshot ticket, restore, and typed cleanup interfaces. The coordinator retains prior Science handling, operation ordering, V2 checkpoints, Gateway and SSH sequencing, CompensationOutcome aggregation, binding commit, visible DTO and text, and recovery projection.

the existing snapshot filesystem, pending-cleanup manifest and CAS, typed AuthorityCleanupOutcome, and CompensationOutcome contracts are reused without product or crash-recovery changes
the coordinator retains prior Science stop, operation ordering, checkpoints, Gateway and SSH sequencing, binding commit, compensation funnel, visible DTO and text, and recovery projection
the exact candidate 15-suite source gate and clean-context completion review remain pending, so this record does not yet claim S5 DONE
PriorStopIntent or Outcome, S6 GatewayController, Gateway or Skill behavior changes, host-neutral extension, artifact, installed, live, signing, and release validation are excluded
